title: Wolf Pack Menace
description: Old Yarrow lost four sheep to something that worked his pen latch open instead of breaking it. Marek has tracked the pack south of Thornfield to a leader smarter than anything he has hunted. He is not going in alone.

objectives.description: Follow the tracks to the pack's ground south of Thornfield
Defeat the dire wolf that's been working the latches

notes: Threat: named farmer Yarrow (invented for this quest only, prose colour) loses stock to a pack working farms south of Thornfield. Distinct from eastern_wolves (loggers, east side, encroachment cause) and tharins_wolf_problem (Elder Moor road, trust test): this pack is smarter and organized, targeting pens specifically.
